response.overview: Greedy, dishonest business people exploit poor fishermen on Coral Islands fishing village. Aun Bant Nant, is a young Salone against this exploitation, vows to eradicate poverty in his native home. His girlfriend, Hla Htaik Khaung is constantly harrassed by a crooked businessman, Michael, trying to lure her into marriage. Her tragic fate leaves behind a daughter to Aun Bant Nant who is unaware of this. His move to Yangon changes his life in a way that allows him to fulfill his aspiration to improve his native land.
response.title: Rising Sun on The Horizon
